CREATE TRIGGER "TR_AdministratorAuditRecords_NoDeleteWithinRetentionFloor"
BEFORE DELETE ON "AdministratorAuditRecords"
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN OLD."RecordedAtUtcTicks" >
    CAST((julianday('now') - 1721425.5) * 864000000000 AS INTEGER) - 155520000000000
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AdministratorAuditRecords is write-once: a record inside the 180 day retention floor cannot be deleted.');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "TR_AdministratorAuditRecords_NoReplace"
BEFORE INSERT ON "AdministratorAuditRecords"
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "AdministratorAuditRecords" WHERE "AuditRecordId" = NEW."AuditRecordId")
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AdministratorAuditRecords is write-once: an existing audit record cannot be replaced.');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "TR_AdministratorAuditRecords_NoUpdate"
BEFORE UPDATE ON "AdministratorAuditRecords"
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AdministratorAuditRecords is write-once: an audit record cannot be updated.');
END
